bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, held the $157 July low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖，守住 7 月 $157 低点

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 16.4% on Nov 5 to $167.52, trading $156.00–188.80 on 2.3 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($196.27), 10-day ($204.74), 30-day ($242.96) and 100-day ($243.16) and the rising 200-day ($222.27). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($230.84), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月5日下跌 16.4%，收于 $167.52，盘中区间 $156.00–188.80，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.3 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$196.27）、10 日（$204.74）、30 日（$242.96）和 100 日均线（$243.16）以及上行的 200 日均线（$222.27）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$230.84），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $194.2–197.5, $189–190.6 and $185.9 supports, now resistance; the $156 low dipped under the $157.33 Jul 29 low, but the close recovered above it. Resistance is $185.9–189 (Aug 24 and Oct 23 lows, Nov 5 high), then $194.2–196.3 (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows, 5-day) and $204.7 (10-day). Support is $156–157.3, then $147.6–149.3 (Mar 3 and Mar 16 lows). A close above $189 would target $194–196; below $156, $148–149.

r.en: Aug 24 low $185.9; Nov 5 high $188.8; Oct 23 low $189, lost
